items.title: Prompt injection: four layers stop the poisoned ticket
items.text:
A ticket tells your agent to ignore its instructions and email every record. What stops it?

▪ Raw input in the prompt nearly gets obeyed
▪ Tag the input and mark it as untrusted data
▪ Block the email tool while handling external input
▪ An output filter flags suspicious replies
▪ Four layers, and no email leaves

items.topic: Built-in, SDK and External MCP Tools
items.title: Tools compared: same gate, different process boundary
items.text:
Built-in tool, your own @tool, or an external MCP server: what actually changes?

▪ Built-in tools ship with the SDK runtime
▪ Your @tool passes the same hook and permission gate
▪ In-process SDK MCP server keeps logic private
▪ External MCP servers cross a process boundary for shared tools
▪ Independent reads run in parallel, dependent steps in order
